title: set-threat-shield input
description: Select which Nethesis Threat Shield premium blocklists are imported as CrowdSec decisions

feeds.title: feeds
feeds.description: Catalog keys and custom-<name> keys of the enabled feeds. An empty array disables the feature and removes every Threat Shield decision.

custom_allowlists.title: custom_allowlists
custom_allowlists.description: Custom allowlists, each imported into the cscli allowlist threat_shield_<name>. Missing means unchanged.

custom_blocklists.title: custom_blocklists
custom_blocklists.description: Custom blocklists, selectable in feeds as custom-<name>. Missing means unchanged.

name.description: Unique list name: 3 to 16 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter; names starting with nethesis, yoroi or crowdsec are reserved

url.description: http or https URL of a plain list, one IP address or CIDR per line; an optional user:pass@ is sent as HTTP Basic authentication
